title: OpenCloudAgentsRunEnvelope
description: Canonical schema for machine-readable audit execution run envelopes in Open Cloud Agents.

$schema.description: URI of the run envelope schema version.

commit_sha.description: Git commit SHA of the audited changeset.

base_sha.description: Base Git commit SHA for PR comparisons.

pr_number.description: Pull request number if running in CI context.

schema_version.description: Semantic version of the findings/envelope schema.

engine_version.description: Version of Open Cloud Agents CLI/engine.

timestamp_utc.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of audit invocation.

risk_tier.description: Blast radius risk tier (0: Docs, 1: App Logic, 2: Infrastructure).

invoked_by.description: Entity or workflow that initiated the audit.

agent_manifest.description: Mapping of activated agent names to their model identifiers.

tool_manifest.description: Mapping of executed tools to version or digest.
